request: Require statistically superior pace before mainline fixing; extend simulations when sampling evidence is insufficient.

behavior.comparison: Each candidate pace must beat both competitors with lower confidence gap strictly greater than explicit min_gap.
behavior.sequential_method: Hoeffding pairwise bounds, delta(k)=alpha/(6*k*(k+1)), predeclared cumulative sample sizes.
behavior.additional_trials: Continue same fixed ensemble and same seed prefix; stop on confirmation or explicit maximum.
behavior.no_confirmation: Do not fix mainline; retain conditional scenario comparisons.
behavior.selection_boundary: Raw conditional API is hypothesis only; confirmed selector recomputes all adaptive look evidence.

limitations: MC error guarantee assumes fixed iid empirical ensemble and predeclared cumulative look counts.
Additional simulations do not increase independent real-race training observations or correct model bias.
Actual data-trained pace draws, temporal calibration and production integration remain incomplete.
Evidence validation checks internal consistency, not authenticity of caller inputs.
